source: Curated by AGEX. Every instruction skill is pinned to a commit and verified by SHA-256; every MCP server is pinned to a package version.

skills.name: Systematic Debugging
skills.description: Find the root cause before fixing: reproduce, trace, form one hypothesis at a time, and prove the fix.
skills.author: Jesse Vincent (Superpowers)

skills.name: Test-Driven Development
skills.description: Write a failing test first, make it pass, then clean up. Keeps changes small and proven.
skills.author: Jesse Vincent (Superpowers)

skills.name: Verify Before Done
skills.description: Agents must run the checks and show the evidence before they say work is finished.
skills.author: Jesse Vincent (Superpowers)

skills.name: Writing Plans
skills.description: Turn a request into a step-by-step implementation plan with files, tests and checkpoints.
skills.author: Jesse Vincent (Superpowers)

skills.name: Code Review
skills.description: A structured review of finished work against its requirements, with issues ranked by severity.
skills.author: Jesse Vincent (Superpowers)
skills.compatibility_note: Written for agents that can start a separate reviewer; other agents follow the same checklist themselves.

skills.name: Security Best Practices
skills.description: Language- and framework-specific security review (Go, JavaScript, Python web stacks) with concrete fixes.
skills.author: OpenAI

skills.name: Threat Model
skills.description: Writes a threat model for the project: trust boundaries, assets, attack paths and mitigations.
skills.author: OpenAI

skills.name: Fix GitHub CI
skills.description: Reads failing GitHub Actions checks on a pull request, explains the failure and proposes a fix.
skills.author: OpenAI

skills.name: Address PR Comments
skills.description: Collects review comments on the current pull request and works through them.
skills.author: OpenAI

skills.name: Browser Automation (Playwright CLI)
skills.description: Drive a real browser from the terminal: open pages, fill forms, take screenshots, extract data.
skills.author: OpenAI

skills.name: Web App Testing
skills.description: Test a local web app with Playwright for Python: check behaviour, capture screenshots and console logs.
skills.author: Anthropic

skills.name: Frontend Design
skills.description: Guidance for deliberate visual design of user interfaces: layout, typography and a distinct look.
skills.author: Anthropic

skills.name: PDF Documents
skills.description: Read, create and check PDF files, including visual checks of rendered pages.
skills.author: OpenAI

skills.name: Jupyter Notebooks
skills.description: Create clean, well-structured notebooks for experiments and tutorials.
skills.author: OpenAI

skills.name: Browser (Playwright MCP)
skills.description: Lets agents open web pages, click, type and read pages in a real browser.
skills.author: Microsoft
skills.compatibility_note: MCP servers are passed to Codex and Claude Code for each request. Antigravity and Gemini CLI read MCP servers only from their own settings, so AGEX does not pass it to them.

skills.name: Chrome DevTools
skills.description: Lets agents inspect a Chrome page: console, network requests and performance traces.
skills.author: Google Chrome DevTools team
skills.compatibility_note: MCP servers are passed to Codex and Claude Code for each request. Antigravity and Gemini CLI read MCP servers only from their own settings, so AGEX does not pass it to them. Needs Google Chrome.

skills.name: Library Docs (Context7)
skills.description: Gives agents current documentation for programming libraries instead of outdated memory.
skills.author: Upstash

skills.name: Web Research (Fetch)
skills.description: Lets agents download a web page and read it as text.
skills.author: Model Context Protocol project
skills.compatibility_note: MCP servers are passed to Codex and Claude Code for each request. Antigravity and Gemini CLI read MCP servers only from their own settings, so AGEX does not pass it to them. It can reach local network addresses; use it only with sites you trust.

skills.name: Git & GitHub
skills.description: Lets agents read and manage GitHub issues, pull requests, reviews and Actions with your token.
skills.author: GitHub
skills.compatibility_note: MCP servers are passed to Codex and Claude Code for each request. Antigravity and Gemini CLI read MCP servers only from their own settings, so AGEX does not pass it to them. Needs a GitHub personal access token.
skills.release_notes: Uses GitHub's hosted MCP endpoint. Your token is stored in the system keychain and passed by environment variable, never on a command line.
